HapSearch provides overview dashboards for species, marker, haplotype, sample, and project coverage, marker exploration with multiple sequence alignment and variant annotation views, and haplotype exploration with sample and project context.

{{< tool-tags >}}
:::

## Good fit for

- Searching microhaplotypes across breeding projects and species
- Comparing marker sequences with multiple sequence alignment
- Reviewing which samples and projects carry a haplotype
